source_name: European Banking Federation — Slovakia country page & Facts & Figures (SBA is the EBF national member)
why_relevant: SBA has been an EBF member since 1996; EBF publishes a standardised annual Slovakia chapter (number of licensed institutions, branches, employees, ownership structure, technology adoption incl. contactless/instant payments) sourced from the association itself — a clean cross-country-comparable aggregate.

source_name: European Payment Council (EPC) — SBA membership / scheme participant registers
why_relevant: SBA joined the EPC in 1996; EPC maintains SEPA scheme adherence registers (SCT, SCT Inst, SDD) listing every adhering Slovak PSP — an authoritative pointer to which SK institutions are live on instant payments and when.

source_name: SBA Educa, s.r.o. — training/exam arm of the association
why_relevant: Association subsidiary running statutory exams for financial intermediaries; exam volumes and syllabi are a weak indirect indicator of distribution-channel size and regulatory focus areas.

source_name: Asociácia leasingových spoločností SR (ALS SR) — statistics
why_relevant: Sector association covering ~90% of the SK leasing market, publishing monthly and annual aggregated financing volumes from members (EUR 3.361bn new business 2023; EUR 5.4bn portfolio). Member-aggregated data unavailable per company; relevant for the non-bank half of sector=both.

source_name: FINAS — Fintech & Insurtech Association of Slovakia
why_relevant: Second, newer SK fintech/insurtech association; separate member base from Slovenská FinTech asociácia, so both are needed for full coverage of the non-bank payments actor map.

source_name: Slovenská banková asociácia — LinkedIn channel
why_relevant: Fast-moving distribution channel for SBA statistics and statements, sometimes carrying charts before the website post; useful as an early-warning trigger for new monthly card releases.

source_name: LobbyFacts / EU Transparency Register datacard — Slovenská banková asociácia
why_relevant: Structured transparency-register profile of the association: declared budget, staff, EU-level interests and affiliations. Useful for assessing the association's capacity and bias when interpreting its statistics, and for confirming its federation memberships.

source_name: Wikipédia (sk) — Slovenská banková asociácia / Úverový register
why_relevant: Cheap orientation layer giving official Slovak names, founding dates, and outbound links to association and register bodies; used purely as a pointer for terminology and actor discovery, never as an evidence source.

source_name: Slovenská sporiteľňa – Finančné ukazovatele / Investori (annual reports, Pillar 3, quarterly results)
why_relevant: Landing page of Slovakia's largest retail bank (~2.3m clients) for výročné správy, NBS Opatrenie 16/2014 Pillar 3 disclosures and quarterly figures; annual reports historically carry card counts, ATM/branch network and digital-channel KPIs that let national card/ATM totals be decomposed by bank.

source_name: Slovenská sporiteľňa – Aktuality (press releases / quarterly results announcements)
why_relevant: Quarterly and annual results releases plus product/milestone press items; SLSP routinely announces client counts, mobile-app (George) users, contactless and mobile-payment milestones — the fastest-cadence quantitative micro-data for the largest SK bank.

source_name: Slovenská sporiteľňa – Pre médiá (press contacts / media section)
why_relevant: Entry point to the communications department and to media materials; useful for direct data requests (card/ATM/POS breakdowns not published) and for locating press-kit assets.

source_name: VÚB banka – Výročné správy (annual report hub)
why_relevant: Second-largest SK bank (Intesa Sanpaolo group). Ročná finančná správa / výročná správa in ESEF+PDF; business review sections describe card portfolio, ATM network and merchant-acquiring (POS terminal) activity — key for share-of-market decomposition.

source_name: VÚB banka – Platobný terminál (merchant acquiring product page)
why_relevant: Acquiring product page: terminal types offered, pricing/fee logic and occasionally claims about installed terminal base. Indirect evidence on POS terminal economics and vendor mix in SK.

source_name: VÚB banka – cenníky (fee schedules, retail and corporate)
why_relevant: Fee schedules reveal the card/ATM/POS product taxonomy of the bank (withdrawal fees at own vs foreign ATM, terminal rental, transaction fees) — a proxy for cash-usage economics and for how the bank segments card products.

source_name: Tatra banka – Výročné správy (annual reports, PDF archive)
why_relevant: Third-largest SK bank (Raiffeisen Bank International group) and the digital-payments innovator (mobile payments, BLIK, Viamo). Annual reports include business-line commentary with digital-transaction and card KPIs.

source_name: Tatra banka – Blog / návody a novinky (product and payment-behaviour posts)
why_relevant: Bank-authored posts that quote in-house adoption figures (e.g. number of clients using contactless mobile payments, BLIK launch as a Slovak first) — quotable micro-data on mobile vs card vs cash behaviour.

source_name: Tatra banka – Sadzobník poplatkov (fee schedule)
why_relevant: Sadzobník exposes ATM withdrawal pricing (own/foreign network), card issuance/maintenance fees and transaction-fee structure — the pricing side of cash vs card substitution.

source_name: ČSOB Slovensko – Informácie zverejňované ročne (NBS Opatrenie 16/2014 / Pillar 3)
why_relevant: ČSOB SK's annual Pillar 3 disclosure under NBS Opatrenie č. 16/2014; contains structured balance-sheet, business-line and network information for a top-5 SK bank whose SK-specific numbers are otherwise buried in KBC group reporting.

source_name: ČSOB Finančná skupina – CSR / non-financial report
why_relevant: Sustainability/CSR reporting increasingly carries branch, ATM and digital-channel accessibility counts (barrier-free ATMs, digital adoption) that do not appear in the financial statements.

source_name: 365.bank (ex-Poštová banka) – Výročné správy
why_relevant: 365.bank/Poštová banka is the digital-first bank with the widest physical footprint via Slovenská pošta (1,300+ points of sale, ~122 PFS offices); its annual reports quantify client numbers, network points and digital adoption — a distinctive cash-access channel in SK.

source_name: 365.bank – Investori
why_relevant: Investor section aggregating bond-issuer disclosures, interim reports and regulatory publications; pointer to the full document set beyond the annual report.

source_name: Slovenská pošta – Výročná správa (postal network as bank distribution/cash channel)
why_relevant: Slovenská pošta is the distribution partner of 365.bank/Poštová banka; its annual report quantifies post-office counts and financial-service transaction volumes — an indirect read on rural cash access and on Poštová banka's reach.

source_name: Prima banka – Finančné správy (annual and periodic financial reports)
why_relevant: Retail bank branded 'jediná v každom okrese' (present in every district) — its report describes branch and ATM footprint and retail client base, useful for regional cash-access and network-share analysis. Reports published as PDF and XHTML/ESEF.

source_name: UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia – Výsledky / výročné a polročné správy (SK site)
why_relevant: Operates in SK as a branch of the Czech entity; SK-language annual and half-year reports (and issuer reports) are the only place its combined CZ/SK loan, deposit, client and card-business figures are disclosed in Slovak. Needed to avoid a hole when decomposing national totals.

source_name: mBank S.A., pobočka zahraničnej banky – SK blog / newsroom
why_relevant: mBank SK publishes no separate Slovak annual report (branch of a Polish bank); its SK blog/press posts are the main channel where it states Slovak client counts and product milestones (e.g. 250,000 SK clients), otherwise invisible in SK statutory filings.

source_name: Erste Group Investor Relations – financial reports and presentations (Slovakia segment)
why_relevant: Erste reports Slovakia as a separate geographic segment each quarter, with English-language segment tables and presentation slides; the fastest cross-checkable quarterly series for SLSP and often earlier than the Slovak annual report. Erste's CDN also hosts SLSP's own PDFs.

source_name: FinStat – bank company profiles and filed účtovné závierky (SLSP, VÚB, Tatra banka, 365.bank, mBank branch)
why_relevant: Aggregator that mirrors filed Slovak financial statements and registry data per legal entity, including foreign-bank branches (mBank, UniCredit) whose SK figures are hard to isolate. Good normalisation layer and entity-ID (IČO) crosswalk for bank-by-bank series.

source_name: Banky.sk – bank profiles and card-market articles
why_relevant: Slovak banking portal that compiles per-bank card and network figures and cites the underlying bank/NBS releases — an efficient pointer for discovering which banks published which KPI and when.

source_name: Kurzy-online.sk – ATM location directory by bank
why_relevant: Third-party directory listing ATMs per bank with a running count (e.g. a stated SLSP figure of 624 ATMs) and locations — a bottom-up proxy for each bank's ATM fleet when the bank does not disclose it, and a check on bank-reported network sizes.
